title: History & Heritage
scope: A curated historical reading guide to the lake and park, with dated records and explicit source limitations. Not an exhaustive history or a current visitor-information service.
overview: Taquaral Lake lies within the park commonly called Parque Portugal in Campinas. The lake, the surrounding park and its cultural facilities have different naming and development histories. This guide keeps those subjects distinct.

events.title: The name Parque Portugal
events.summary: A municipal account identifies Law 356, dated July 14, 1950, as the earlier naming instrument for the park.
events.notes: A naming date is distinct from the park opening date. The original 1950 law has not been independently inspected.

events.title: Municipal park inauguration
events.summary: The municipality records the inauguration of the park on November 5, 1972. Its site had belonged to Fazenda Taquaral.
events.notes: This dates the park inauguration, not necessarily creation of the lake or construction of every attraction.

events.title: A planetarium project is proposed
events.summary: A retrospective account by the Planetário describes a 1981 proposal led by Unicamp professors for a planetarium in Campinas.
events.notes: Only the year is supported here. This proposal is not the opening of the planetarium.

events.title: A science-education partnership
events.summary: The same account records a 1982 agreement involving Unicamp, the municipality, Funcamp and the state academy of sciences that enabled acquisition of planetarium equipment.
events.notes: The retrospective abstract is the source; the original signed agreement was not inspected.

events.title: The Planetário opens
events.summary: The Planetário account dates its opening to October 28, 1987. Unicamp also corroborates an October 1987 opening.
events.notes: The day comes from the 2003 abstract; the university article gives the month and year.

events.title: Historical field campaigns
events.summary: The USP thesis describes sampling in March, May and August 2000. Reviewed surface records from those campaigns support the V4 and V5 modules.
events.notes: These water-quality campaign dates do not establish the date of the bathymetric survey. No statement about present water conditions is implied.

events.title: A doctoral study is defended
events.summary: USP records October 24, 2002 as the defense date of Esperanza Hernández Piedrahíta’s doctoral study of the lake.
events.notes: The repository publication date is December 1, 2016. Defense, fieldwork and online publication are different events.

events.title: Sediment removal is reported
events.summary: A later municipal report describes dredging in 2016 and reports removal of 63,000 cubic meters of sediment.
events.notes: This is reported sediment removal, not lake water volume, current capacity or a quantified comparison with the thesis bathymetry. No exact work dates are established here.

events.title: The park name honors an architect
events.summary: Municipal news reports Law 16,597, sanctioned July 4, 2024, adding Arquiteto Denis Roberto Castro Perez to the name Parque Portugal.
events.notes: The report dates publication to July 5, 2024. This entry concerns the park designation; it does not establish a change to the lake waterbody name.

events.title: A dated paving progress report
events.summary: On August 19, 2025, the municipality reported 2,350 linear meters of interlocking pavement installed along the internal track.
events.notes: The stated aims included accessibility and reducing sediment input. The report is not proof of measured environmental improvement or confirmation of later completion.

uncertainties.title: Lake formation chronology
uncertainties.text: The thesis describes construction in 1968, while the municipality reports a 1950 park-naming law referring to an existing lake. These may describe different stages or works; this project has not reconciled the chronology. No definitive lake-formation date is assigned.

uncertainties.title: Land transfer history
uncertainties.text: Municipal accounts describe the site as former Fazenda Taquaral land. Donation and acquisition narratives were not reconciled against original deeds; a precise transfer date or legal mechanism is not asserted.

uncertainties.title: Names are not interchangeable
uncertainties.text: Parque Portugal is a park designation. OSM identifies the waterbody as Lagoa Isaura Teles Alves de Lima. Historical spelling and the separate lake-naming instrument were not independently verified in this module.

uncertainties.title: No historical reconstruction from imagery
uncertainties.text: No archival photograph, georeferenced historical boundary or measured change series is supplied by this module. V7 imagery from 2025 is a separate source; it does not illustrate the earlier events.

rights_note: English summaries were prepared for this educational project. Sources retain their own rights; links are provided for consultation. No archival photographs or full external texts are redistributed.

limits: This final edition concludes the educational series; it is not a certified operational product.
No LAS/LAZ point cloud is integrated; access and survey metadata remain unconfirmed for this project.
No live satellite feed, current bathymetric survey, real-time water-quality monitoring or validated environmental prediction is included.
Automated checks and source review do not substitute for field validation. Browser appearance and interactions require local manual verification.
